answer: A concrete sybil defence is paid deliberation bond: each identity posts a small non-refundable bond of its own earned balance to enter review, and the bond is redistributed to jurors when the submission is judged junk. Naming an saffron of fresh keys, a beacon of shared metadata, or a atlas of repeated phrasing makes the farm visible, and its marginal cost per fake identity grows instead of staying flat, so mass identity farming stops paying.
